semiconductor_relevance: Medium — LUZTECH provides critical valves and filtration solutions for managing specialty gases and chemicals in semiconductor fabrication processes.
summary: LUZTECH CO., LTD. specializes in manufacturing and supplying valves and filtration solutions essential for semiconductor fabrication. Their products, including ball valves, plastic valves, line valves, regulators, and filters, are crucial for handling specialty gases and chemicals in the semiconductor industry.
